title: Grayton Dream on 30A's Grayton Beach | Ocean Reef Resorts
meta_description: Nestled just steps from the pristine sands of Grayton Beach, this newly renovated and furnished four-bedroom vacation home comfortably accommodates up to twelve guests with its various beds and bunks, making it an ideal retreat for family reunions or getaways.
description_expanded: Nestled just steps from the pristine sands of  Grayton Beach, this newly renovated and furnished four-bedroom vacation home comfortably accommodates up to twelve guests with its various beds and bunks, making it an ideal retreat for family reunions or getaways. Captivating Coastal Living Embrace the beauty of Grayton Beach at  Grayton Dream, which features two expansive verandas spanning the home's width, allowing for breathtaking views over the Gulf and the untouched landscapes of Grayton Beach State Park Preserve. As recognized by Forbes Magazine, this stretch of coast offers a front-row seat to pristine, crystal-white dunes and vibrant turquoise waters. A sandy trail leads directly from your doorstep to the beach for quick access to the shimmering sea. Enjoy the privilege of viewing spectacular sunsets from your west-facing balcony, which paints the evening sky in brilliant hues year-round. Elegant Interiors with a View The heart of the home features a spacious open-plan living area with floor-to-ceiling windows and double glass doors that frame the majestic seascape. These panoramic vistas can be enjoyed from the comfort of the living room or out on the veranda, which is equipped with a dining table, a couch, and a lounge chair—perfect for sunset soirees. The living space is styled with tropical elegance, featuring white slip-covered sofas, cushioned chairs with straw rope accents, and a square white cocktail table centered around a flat-screen TV. Modern Amenities Experience top-notch convenience with modern amenities throughout the home, including a Sonos speaker system for immersive audio experiences, four new smart TVs for entertainment in every room, and Fisher Paykel appliances in the kitchen. The kitchen also features an induction stove and a separate beverage refrigerator, ensuring that your culinary adventures are as enjoyable as they are effortless. Artistic Touches and Luxe Comfort The décor throughout the home includes vibrant local paintings, whimsical sculptures, and cheerful seaside motifs, creating a joyful and inviting atmosphere. The dining area, under unique straw-woven light fixtures, seats ten comfortably, with additional seating available at a royal blue-tiled bar, ideal for enjoying snacks or drinks. The fully equipped kitchen is ready for your culinary adventures. Accommodations for Every Guest The home features thoughtfully designed guest quarters to ensure privacy and comfort. The first floor hosts a twin bedroom with an en-suite bath and a colorful bunk room for four, with a connected full hall bathroom. The upper floor features two suites, each with tropical furnishings and a spa-inspired en-suite bathroom. Each suite offers access to a shared sun deck with lounging and dining options, set against the stunning seascape, and serves as a perfect spot for stargazing. Vibrant Local Scene Just a short walk away, the village center of Grayton Beach offers unique galleries, chic boutiques, and popular dining spots, including the famous Red Bar , known for its lively atmosphere and live music. Nearby, picturesque coastal villages along Scenic 30A feature additional restaurants, beach bars, shops, and host regular festivals and seasonal fireworks. Experience your very own "Grayton Dream" where luxury meets comfort in the heart of 30A's scenic coastline. First Floor: Covered Parking. Second Floor: Living Room with Balcony Access, Dining, Kitchen, Bedroom with Two Twin Beds and Walk-in Shower, Bunk Room with Two Twin Bunks and Shared Tub/Shower Combo, Laundry. Third Floor: King Bedroom with Walk-in Shower and Balcony Access, Bedroom with Two Queen Beds and Walk-in Shower + Balcony Access.
